title.narrative: Nexus North: support towards strengthening water utilities in the North of the West Bank

description.narrative: The project includes infrastructure water works with the main objectives of secure drinking water production capacity, extend and optimize service networks; infrastructure energy works to supply the water infrastructure with renewable energy; engineering supervision; capacity building, institutional support and technical assistance to JSCs to strengthen their capacity to, operate and maintain infrastructure, and to support the implementation of sectoral reform.

comment.narrative: At the time of the signature of the delegation agreement no cluster Water Utilies merged were existing

The creation of cluster for both Tubas and Jenin areas failed. At issue the difficulties between Tubas JSC and Mayhtaloun JSC Tubas area the lack of competencies of TA to produce operational documents for the merging and bylaw not operational yet on PWA side. World Bank finances a feasability study that should bring a methodology for the creation of RWU
The creation of cluster or Regional Water Utility has not been yet completed as implementation of the reform is slowing down

description.narrative: Water sector and regulationsstatemently ongoing

title.narrative: Establishment of 2 clusters

description.narrative: Establishment of a Jenin North and Tubas Cluster

comment.narrative: At the time of the signature of the delegation agreement no cluster Water Utilies merged were existing

The creation of cluster for both Tubas and Jenin areas failed. At issue the difficulties between Tubas JSC and Mayhtaloun JSC Tubas area the lack of competencies of TA to produce operational documents for the merging and bylaw not operational yet on PWA side. World Bank finances a feasability study that should bring a methodology for the creation of RWU
The creation of cluster or Regional Water Utility has not been yet completed as implementation of the reform is slowing down
